title: Chasin Tyde Charters

services.name: Cobia fishing
services.desc: Outer Banks Cobia fishing can be world class during the months of May and June even though they can be targeted all summer long. Cobia show up along our beaches, inlets and shoals during their migration. Some of the Cobia caught here on the Outer Banks can get up to 100 pounds. The CHASINTYDE has a custom tower which gives us the ability to target, spot and sight cast jigs on these fish. Our preferred jigs of choice are Meathog Jigs tied locally right here on the outer banks. Not only will you enjoy the fight these fish offer, they are excellent eating also. My goal is to provide you with the best fishing experience while being safe and having fun. Come fish with us on the CHASINTYDE. There
